info.title: Sendly Creator Paywall
info.description: HTTP 402 paywall API with Arc USDC settlement via ZkSend to a social identity (twitter, github, twitch, gmail, linkedin, telegram). Clients should read the target platform and handle from the 402 response at paywall.recipient.

servers.description: Local zk host (paywall UI; API still hits Supabase)

get.description: Returns unlocked content when a valid Sendly payment ID or Arc transaction hash is provided. Otherwise returns HTTP 402 with payment instructions.

402.description: Payment required - pay via ZkSend.createPayment on Arc

post.description: Creates a paid content page. Creator must be authenticated. GitHub identities are verified; other platforms are attested.

get.description: Returns a public creator profile and active article metadata. Does not return contentBody.

post.description: Idempotent upsert of creator profile. GitHub identities are verified; other platforms are attested.

patch.description: Updates displayName, bio, and avatarUrl for the authenticated profile owner.

post.description: Requires X-Hub-Signature-256 (HMAC-SHA256). Handles pull_request (merge payout, bounty resolve, review settle), issues (bounty:<amount> label), release (published → split pool among authors), and pull_request_review (review escrow). Unknown events are ignored.

get.description: Lists repo payout receipts for all kinds: merge, bounty, release, and review.

200.description: Payout events with kind, txHash, claimStatus, and skipReason

get.description: Lists repo payout policies, including sponsor pool, per-PR amount, and caps.

post.summary: Upsert payout policy for a demo repo

post.description: Runs a demo research agent and performs real 402-style payments for registered paywall slugs.

Handles webhook_callback_verification by returning the challenge, notification (channel.raid → pay twitch:uid:{raider}), and revocation. HMAC uses Twitch-Eventsub-Message-Signature over message_id + timestamp + body.

200.description: Webhook accepted, revocation accepted, or challenge returned

patch.description: Updates campaign status, budget, and dates.

post.summary: Upsert raid payout policy for a campaign

200.description: Payout events with txHash, claimStatus, and skipReason

MoneyUsdc.description: USDC decimal amount as a string to avoid floating-point rounding issues.

identity.description: Canonical social identity, for example github:hazyshades or twitch:uid:123456.

ratePerViewerUsdc.description: USDC per raiding viewer; amount = min(viewers × rate, maxPerEventUsdc)

x-demo-pricing.note: Live demo snapshot (Jul 2026). Raid formula: min(viewers * ratePerViewerUsdc, maxPerEventUsdc).
